This is the named digital publisher, not a commercial record-label claim. The stated source is a Sony MZ-N1 MiniDisc recorder.

Eric Pancer — recordist (credited as taper) Documented

Unknown Unknown

The date of transfer from MiniDisc is not supplied. Upload and derivative creation dates are not treated as transfer dates.

Processing
Sony MZ-N1 MiniDisc source; Archive 128 kbps MP3 original and Ogg Vorbis derivative; Commons MP3 access derivative Documented

Archive dso-2004-05-22_1.ogg is marked derivative of dso-2004-05-22_1.mp3. Commons names Xiph.Org libVorbis I 20040629. Microphones, editing and restoration are undocumented.

[2] [1]
Composition rights
Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies. Inferred, not documented

Mahler died in 1911. This is a term calculation, not a worldwide clearance or a claim about an unidentified modern edition.

[3] [4]
Recording rights
Commons applies CC0 1.0 Universal to this recording. Documented

The upstream Archive item links the older Creative Commons public-domain dedication and asks derivatives to recognise performers. Commons is the selected rights source; the uploader’s authority to waive all performers’ rights is not independently established.
